channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: EU Investigates Booking.com for Fraud and Phishing Risks
item.description: European Union regulators have launched an investigation into Booking.com, citing concerns over the accommodation website's handling of fraudulent listings and phishing scams. The European Commission has described the company's approach to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Guatemalan Man Gets 30 Years for Texas Smuggling Deaths
item.description: A Guatemalan man has been sentenced to 30 years in prison for his role in a smuggling operation that resulted in the deaths of 53 people in Texas. The sentencing follows the tragedy where the victims were found deceased. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: DOJ Considers Election Litigation in Multiple States
item.description: The Department of Justice (DOJ) is reportedly considering election litigation against additional states. This development comes as some states are preparing for the possibility of federal election interference. The specific states or the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian MP Attacked, Raising Concerns Over Legislator Safety
item.description: Australian Parliamentarian Andrew Haines was attacked, prompting discussions about the escalating threats faced by legislators both online and within their communities. The incident has spurred a reckoning over safety measures for public… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: CNN threatens legal action over Air Force One access denial
item.description: CNN has threatened to take new legal action, stating it continues to be denied access to Air Force One. The network is pursuing this course after its access was reportedly restricted. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hungary arrests former central bank chief over alleged corruption
item.description: Hungary has arrested György Matolcsy, the former governor of the Hungarian National Bank and a longtime ally of Prime Minister Viktor Orbán. The arrest is part of a new government investigation into alleged corruption. Matolcsy served as… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Publisher Cuts Ties with Author Over Alleged AI Novel Creation
item.description: Quebec author Thélyson Orélien has had ties cut by his publisher following allegations that he used artificial intelligence to write his novel. The publisher confirmed the decision, though specific details regarding the AI's role in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australia Extends Ban on KPMG Federal Contracts
item.description: Australia has extended its ban on KPMG from securing federal government contracts until February 2027. The ban was initially imposed due to breaches of confidentiality and misuse of government information. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: White Powder Letters Sent to US Congress Member and Hong Kong Media
item.description: Nancy Pelosi's office in California received a suspicious letter containing white powder on Wednesday, marking the latest in a series of similar mailings sent to various US Congress members ahead of the midterm elections. Separately, two… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Meta Faces Class Action Lawsuit in Australia Over Child Harm Allegations
item.description: Meta Platforms is facing a class action lawsuit in Australia, filed on behalf of children allegedly harmed by social media. The lawsuit claims that Meta's platforms caused psychological harm to young users. This legal action is part of a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: EU Prosecutors Raid Far-Right Group Offices in Funds Probe
item.description: European Union prosecutors have raided the offices of a far-right group in Brussels as part of an investigation into alleged misuse of European Parliament funds. The probe reportedly concerns approximately €4 million in funds. The specific… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: NFL Player Jordan Elliott Released by Titans After Gun Incident
item.description: Tennessee Titans player Jordan Elliott was released by the team after he reportedly pulled a gun following an incident with a teammate during training. The incident led to his subsequent unemployment with the team. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Fatal Hit-and-Run Driver Appears in Court, Police Seek Witnesses
item.description: A driver accused in a fatal hit-and-run incident in Bibra Lake, Perth, has appeared in court. Police are renewing their calls for witnesses to come forward as the investigation continues. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Teacher Describes Oregon School Shooting Survival
item.description: A teacher who survived a school shooting in Oregon recounted the events, stating she had no chance to protect the children. She attempted to close the door, but the shooter was already present. The teacher also described being shot and… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Websites Offline Due to PHP Vulnerability
item.description: Websites worldwide, including government sites in Canada and Europe, were taken offline as a precautionary measure due to a serious vulnerability discovered in the PHP computer language. This language is used to build approximately 70% of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Meta Ordered to Pay $25 Billion in New Mexico Data Privacy Case
item.description: A New Mexico court has ordered Meta to pay a $25 billion penalty after a jury found the company misled consumers regarding data privacy. The ruling is linked to allegations stemming from the Cambridge Analytica scandal, concerning the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Attack on Saudi Airport Kills One, Injures Eight
item.description: An attack on Saudi Arabia's King Fahd International Airport late Wednesday night resulted in one death and eight injuries. The airport sustained damage, and some flights were diverted following the incident. Saudi airports have been… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Chinese-linked hackers use AI to breach global organizations
item.description: Chinese-linked hackers have used artificial intelligence to breach the systems of "hundreds of organizations worldwide," according to Microsoft. The cyberattacks targeted ConnectWise, a company that provides IT services to numerous other… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: IPS officer fires AK-47 during Dussehra ritual, sparking safety debate
item.description: An IPS officer in Chhattisgarh fired an AK-47 rifle during a Dussehra ritual, an event that was captured on video and subsequently went viral. The incident has ignited a debate regarding safety protocols and the appropriateness of such… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Hyderabad Police Rescue Four Birds During Dasara
item.description: During the Dasara festival, Hyderabad Police, in conjunction with the GHSPCA, rescued four Palapitta birds from illegal captivity. The Palapitta is also known as the Indian roller. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Thieves in PPE kits steal jewelry and cash from Ratlam shop
item.description: Three thieves, wearing PPE kits, entered a shop in Ratlam and stole jewelry and cash worth ₹2 lakh. In a twist, the thieves were reportedly deceived by a shop board, stealing artificial jewelry instead of real items. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Minister Rijiju Condemns Racial Abuse of Tripura Youth by Delhi Influencer
item.description: Union Minister Kiren Rijiju has condemned a Delhi-based influencer for racially abusing a young man from Tripura, stating there is "no place for hate" and promising a "hard lesson" for the perpetrator. The incident, captured on video, has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold Smuggling Ring Busted, Rs 9.31 Crore Seized, 5 Arrested
item.description: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) has busted a gold smuggling operation with routes connecting Bangladesh, Kolkata, and Hyderabad, and also at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International (CSMI) Airport in Mumbai. Authorities… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Swimmer Deported from Japan Over Sexual Misconduct Allegations
item.description: Indian para swimmer Mohammad Shams Alam Shaikh has been deported from Japan following allegations of sexual misconduct. The incident occurred while he was in Japan for the Asian Para Games. He was reportedly detained and subsequently… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: 21 Indian Seafarers Safe After Kuwaiti Tanker Hit in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A Kuwait-flagged oil tanker carrying 21 Indian sailors was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. All 21 Indian seafarers on board were reported to be safe following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Indian Railways Cancels 16 Trains for Three Months
item.description: Indian Railways has cancelled 16 trains for a period of three months. The railway authority released figures indicating the extent of improvement in train punctuality across the country. Passengers are advised to check the list of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi High Court Questions CJP Leaders on Legal Approach
item.description: The Delhi High Court questioned leaders of the Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) regarding their decision to approach the court under Article 226, asking why they chose this specific legal remedy. The RSS issued a warning in relation to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: FSSAI Issues Notices to Nestlé India and Zydus Wellness Over Product Claims
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has issued notices to Nestlé India and Zydus Wellness concerning claims made on their products. Nestlé India received notices regarding Lactogen Pro 1 and Nan Excella Pro Stage 1… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Manipur Violence: Three Dead, Protesters Bring Bodies to CM's Residence
item.description: Renewed violence in Manipur has resulted in three deaths, with protesters bringing the bodies to the Chief Minister's residence to demand action. The incident has sparked protests outside the CM's house. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Two sisters killed in truck collision in Baghpat
item.description: Two sisters were killed when a truck collided with them in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh. Another woman was critically injured when a truck hit a motorcycle in Bandlaguda Jagir. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab CM Mann Claims Detention, Accuses Centre of Humiliation
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann was reportedly detained at Delhi Airport for three hours upon his return from France, according to claims by the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). AAP alleged that officials imposed a penalty of ₹50,000 on Mann… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Kenyan Cult Leader Convicted of 191 Murders
item.description: A Kenyan doomsday cult leader has been found guilty of 191 murder charges, including the deaths of 190 children and one adult. The leader was convicted in a trial that a journalist described as a "very painful experience." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Allahabad High Court stays conviction for 2017 murder case
item.description: The Allahabad High Court has stayed the conviction of an individual who was found guilty in a 2017 murder case. This stay allows the individual to contest elections in Uttar Pradesh in 2027. The court's decision was made in relation to the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Nearly $1 Million in Trading Cards Stolen from FedEx Truck
item.description: Approximately $1 million worth of sports and Pokémon trading cards were stolen from a FedEx truck in California. The theft involved two pallets of the valuable collectibles. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Four Soldiers Die in Training Fire at CFB Wainwright
item.description: Four soldiers died in a fire during a military training exercise at Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Wainwright. The incident occurred during a training event, and the cause of the fire is under investigation. The province of Saskatchewan is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: France Imposes Curfews Amidst Weekend Riots
item.description: Following days of rioting, France has introduced localized curfews in areas where required. Authorities are implementing these measures to restore calm after widespread unrest. The curfews are part of a broader crackdown on rioters. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Kashmiri Travellers Alarmed by Bus Attacks in Haryana and Punjab
item.description: Two separate incidents involving attacks on buses carrying Kashmiri travellers have caused alarm. In Haryana, an elderly Kashmiri man was injured when bricks were hurled at a Delhi-Srinagar bus. Subsequently, a similar incident occurred… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 3.

item.title: Australian MP Helen Haines Severely Injured in Targeted Vehicle Attack
item.description: Australian Federal Member for Indi, Helen Haines, sustained severe injuries, including the amputation of her leg, after being deliberately struck multiple times by a car outside her Wangaratta office. Police have charged Brendan Nugent in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Russell Brand rape trial: First accuser testifies in court
item.description: A woman has alleged that Russell Brand told her "it's just fun" as he raped her in a hotel room in 1999 during the Labour party conference. The alleged victim recounted the incident to detectives, stating she "felt dirty and sick"… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi protests: Home Secretary apologizes to Supreme Court in contempt case
item.description: The Union Home Secretary has tendered an unconditional apology to the Supreme Court in a contempt case related to Delhi protests. The Supreme Court's docket also includes a police crackdown and the detention of journalists. Protests in… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 9 · Right 0.
